title: Throttle cold-start: arrivals at tick 0/1 of a fresh run are suppressed though no click has ever played
detail: arrival_last_tick = 0 (also the audio_init zero value) encodes 'clicked at tick 0', not 'never clicked'. An arrival event at tick 0 or 1 after init/reset satisfies 0 < 0+2 / 1 < 0+2 and is silenced + uncaptioned with no prior click. No sentinel distinguishes the never-played state.
recommended_fix: Add a has_clicked bool (or a sentinel such as max(u64)) so the first admitted arrival always plays, then set arrival_last_tick; reset the flag in audio_reset_run.
